techniques_applied: Structured depth pruning: replace MobileNetV2 residual blocks 6, 9, 16 with Identity; no width pruning in selected model
Adaptive BatchNorm: 100 batches of 32 from fixed seed-0 fine-tuning subset
Knowledge distillation from ResNet-50 on 5400 images: 3 epochs, SGD lr 0.001, momentum 0.9, cosine decay, weight decay 4e-5, batch 32, alpha 0.7, temperature 4, seed 0; training on MPS
ONNX opset 13 export; quant_pre_process before static quantization
Static QDQ INT8, per-channel weights, S8S8, Percentile 99.99 recalibration on 300 fixed class-balanced images, seed 42

ai_hub_profile_summary.device: Dragonwing RB3 Gen 2 Vision Kit (QCS6490), closest listed low-power Qualcomm IoT device to the Arduino UNO Q
ai_hub_profile_summary.runtime: ONNX (--target_runtime onnx), all layers on CPU

measurement_machine: Apple M3 Pro, 11 cores, 18 GB RAM, Darwin 25.4.0, CPU only; inference on CPU, recovery training on MPS
evaluation_data: All 27000 EuroSAT images, including fine-tuning and calibration samples, per recorded judge instruction
timing_status: provisional for final; baseline uses five-round milestone from 2026-10-13T12:33:09
timing_notes: Final local timings are a single session at 48.4% background CPU, mains power. A new clean benchmark was refused at 43% CPU on battery. Latency/RAM/energy ratios are provisional cross-session comparisons, not verified paired speedups.
